audit.code:
#!/bin/zsh
# audit.zsh: read back every setting this guide can check. It changes nothing.
d() { defaults read "$@" 2>/dev/null; }
row() {  # label, the guide's value, your value
  if [[ "$2" == "$3" ]]; then
    print -P "%F{green}✓%f ${(r:24:)1} $3"
  else
    print -P "%F{yellow}≠%f ${(r:24:)1} ${3:-unset}, the guide has $2"
  fi
}
pad=com.apple.AppleMultitouchTrackpad
wm=com.apple.WindowManager

row "key repeat"           1    "$(d -g KeyRepeat)"
row "delay until repeat"   15   "$(d -g InitialKeyRepeat)"
row "press and hold"       0    "$(d -g ApplePressAndHoldEnabled)"
row "tracking speed"       3    "$(d -g com.apple.trackpad.scaling)"
row "click pressure"       0    "$(d $pad FirstClickThreshold)"
row "tap to click"         1    "$(d $pad Clicking)"
row "look up"              0    "$(d $pad TrackpadThreeFingerTapGesture)"
row "three finger drag"    1    "$(d $pad TrackpadThreeFingerDrag)"
row "four finger swipe up" 2    "$(d $pad TrackpadFourFingerVertSwipeGesture)"
row "four finger sideways" 2    "$(d $pad TrackpadFourFingerHorizSwipeGesture)"
row "dock size"            16   "$(d com.apple.dock tilesize)"
row "dock magnified size"  128  "$(d com.apple.dock largesize)"
row "dock magnification"   1    "$(d com.apple.dock magnification)"
row "stage manager"        1    "$(d $wm GloballyEnabled)"
row "windows all at once"  1    "$(d $wm AppWindowGroupingBehavior)"
row "tiled window margins" 0    "$(d $wm EnableTiledWindowMargins)"
row "appearance"           Dark "$(d -g AppleInterfaceStyle)"
row "scroll bars"          WhenScrolling "$(d -g AppleShowScrollBars)"
row "tabs for documents"   manual "$(d -g AppleWindowTabbingMode)"

print
osascript -l JavaScript -e 'ObjC.import("AppKit")
$.NSScreen.screens.js.map(s =>
  `${s.localizedName.js}: ${s.frame.size.width} x ${s.frame.size.height} @${s.backingScaleFactor}x`
).join("\n")'

tune.code:
#!/bin/zsh
# tune.zsh: write the values from this guide. Read it before you run it.
osascript -e 'tell application "System Settings" to quit'

# --- Keys
# 225 ms before the first repeat, then one every 15 ms
defaults write -g InitialKeyRepeat -int 15
defaults write -g KeyRepeat -int 1
defaults write -g ApplePressAndHoldEnabled -bool false

# --- Trackpad
# Tracking speed: Fast
defaults write -g com.apple.trackpad.scaling -float 3
defaults -currentHost write -g com.apple.mouse.tapBehavior -int 1

# Tap to click on, Click: Light, Look up: Off
for pad in com.apple.AppleMultitouchTrackpad \
  com.apple.driver.AppleBluetoothMultitouch.trackpad; do
  defaults write $pad Clicking -bool true
  defaults write $pad FirstClickThreshold -int 0
  defaults write $pad SecondClickThreshold -int 0
  defaults write $pad TrackpadThreeFingerTapGesture -int 0
done

# Three fingers drag, four fingers switch
for pad in com.apple.AppleMultitouchTrackpad \
  com.apple.driver.AppleBluetoothMultitouch.trackpad; do
  defaults write $pad TrackpadThreeFingerDrag -bool true
  defaults write $pad TrackpadThreeFingerHorizSwipeGesture -int 0
  defaults write $pad TrackpadThreeFingerVertSwipeGesture -int 0
  defaults write $pad TrackpadFourFingerHorizSwipeGesture -int 2
  defaults write $pad TrackpadFourFingerVertSwipeGesture -int 2
done

# --- Dock
# Size all the way left, Magnification all the way right
defaults write com.apple.dock tilesize -int 16
defaults write com.apple.dock largesize -int 128
defaults write com.apple.dock magnification -bool true

# --- Windows
# Stage Manager on, windows All at Once, recent apps in view
defaults write com.apple.WindowManager GloballyEnabled -bool true
defaults write com.apple.WindowManager AppWindowGroupingBehavior -int 1
defaults write com.apple.WindowManager AutoHide -bool false

# Tiled windows meet edge to edge
defaults write com.apple.WindowManager EnableTiledWindowMargins -bool false

# Prefer tabs when opening documents: Never
defaults write -g AppleWindowTabbingMode -string manual

# --- Look
defaults write -g AppleInterfaceStyle -string Dark
defaults write -g AppleShowScrollBars -string WhenScrolling

killall Dock
print "Log out and back in, then run audit.zsh."
